_comment: Critical surfaces that MUST reference an idempotency primitive. Scanner walks each directory; files matching excludeFilenamePatterns are skipped (models/DTOs/validators/tests aren't mutation entry points). Three levels of non-enforcement: `exceptions` (truly don't need idempotency, e.g., read-only services), `grandfatheredGaps` (known current gaps tracked as warnings — remove from list as each is fixed), and new violations (unexpected — fail CI).

_exceptionNotes.src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi: Read-only service — no mutations, no idempotency needed.

_grandfatheredNotes.src/modules/billingDomain/refunds/refund: TODO: mount Idempotency-Key middleware on POST /refunds when request-level middleware is committed.
TODO: wrap refund execution in ensureIdempotent() keyed on the refund's idempotencyKey field.
_grandfatheredNotes.src/modules/billingDomain/organizationFi: TODO: settings writes should use upsert + conditional update to be naturally idempotent, or wrap in ensureIdempotent.
TODO: ledger writes MUST be idempotent — critical financial path.
TODO: invoice create/update needs idempotency to prevent duplicate invoices on retry.
TODO: status transitions should use conditional update (FROM state filter) to be idempotent by construction.
TODO: CRITICAL — orchestrates ledger writes; any duplicate is a financial correctness bug.
TODO: quotation create/convert needs idempotency keyed on the quotation idempotencyKey.
_grandfatheredNotes.src/jobs/controllers/job.controller.js: TODO: currently uses per-process Map dedup (line 44, processedMessages) — migrate to distributed IdempotencyKey for multi-instance safety. See comment at line 41 acknowledging the known gap.
